title: An error occurred when receiving an offline forms submission: Failed to decompress Zip data
text: The error means the form's data was corrupted during compression. The root cause is often due to the version of the Web browser used when opening the Veslink forms. To address this, download and run the most recent version of browsers and re-send/re-download the off-line Veslink forms.

title: Can I correct the Voyage Number on a Veslink Form?
text: The voyage number on a Veslink Form cannot be changed after the forms have been approved. The best way to resolve this is to reject all of the forms for the specific voyage and resubmit the form with the correct information. [image]

title: Can I move Veslink Forms from one voyage to another if they are approved for the wrong voyage?
text: If a Veslink Forms has been approved for the wrong voyage, they are not transferrable between voyages and cannot be moved. The approved form will need to be rejected, and a new one resent with the correct voyage number. If the Veslink Form has NOT been approved, you can change the voyage number within the form and click approve.

title: Can I submit Veslink form attachments via the API?
text: Yes, agent companies and third-party vendors can submit supplementary attachments via the Veslink API. POST and GET endpoints are available. You should use the form Id/guid from when you initially submitted the form. You can only send an attachment to a form you (or your company) has previously submitted. If you have multiple attachments, you will need to perform one POST per file.

title: How can I indicate that a Veslink form is in local time when submitting forms via API?
text: When submitting a Veslink form via API, you can indicate that a date/time in the form is in local time by removing the time zone suffix from the date/time. Note: for At Sea noon reports, you must indicate a specific time zone; the "Local" option is not available.

title: How do I fix the issue where some of the fields in my custom Form Designer form not appearing in the Port Activities list after submission?
text: This issue can occur if multiple fields in the custom Veslink Form are mapped to the same Port Activity in IMOS, with one conditionally visible. Solutions: Create a new activity in IMOS to better separate the mutually linked fields. Or combine the two fields into one and update the single field's label.

title: How do I register as an agent in Veslink?
text: Access the following link and provide the required information: https://veson.com/veslink-agent-registration/ In order for faster processing, fill out all fields.

title: How to Add Attachments on the Veslink Agent Portal
text: Agents can add attachments to submitted and drafted forms in Veslink Agent Portal. Select one of the links under the Forms column, input necessary information, click Save Draft/Submit, then click "Add Attachment" button. You can add multiple documents at once (max 20MB). NOTE: Attachments in Port Disbursement forms will not be viewable in PDA's "Attachment" button.

title: How to find a veslink form in status Being processed by IMOS and Reject it?
text: Go in Veslink and find the forms in the Dashboard. Identify vessel codes. Use the API to find the forms. Use the GUID to Reject the form: Go in Veslink - Company Name - Company Administration - Veslink - filter by GUID - select 'Reject' to IMOS and click on Reset Forms.

title: I made a change to a vessel in the IMOS, but why is the change not flowing into the Veslink Forms?
text: Every time a change has been made to a vessel within the Vessel screen in IMOS, this will not show on the Veslink Forms already downloaded. You will need to re-download the forms. If platforms haven't synced, navigate to Veslink Settings > System Configuration > Interfaces and perform a master data reset.

title: Importing VFML form
text: Due to security concerns, the VFML form import functionality has been disabled to prevent potential client-side code injection vulnerabilities. To request a form import: Prepare your VFML form file in ZIP format, submit a support ticket through the Help Center, and include explicit permission for the Veson team to import the file.

title: Is it possible to set up different conditions to auto approve Veslink forms?
text: This is not currently possible in IMOS, the auto-approval only works at a form level rather than based on specific fields. We recommend setting Validations and Warnings at a form element level.

title: What does the 'Voyage has No Arrived Ports' error mean on my Departure Notice?
text: This error will be shown when there are no ports in 'Arrival' Status, meaning either there have been no submitted Arrival Notices OR all ports already have a Departure Notice submitted. [image]

title: What happens to my data when I reject a previously approved Veslink form?
text: Rejecting the forms does not mean the voyage data is reversed in the IMOS database. There are no automatic changes to the voyage data imported from the forms when they were accepted. You will have to manually update the voyage to reverse any changes.

title: What is the correct order for submitting Veslink forms?
text: Forms can be sent in any order, but they need to be approved in a specific order: Arrival Notice, Noon Report in Port, Cargo Handling Form, Bunkering Form, Departure Notice, Statement of Facts. Once approved, changes cannot be made to the form.

title: When should the "In Transit" option be used in a noon report?
text: The "In transit" option would be used in a noon report while the vessel is navigating the passing point or canal, whereas "At Sea" is used when the vessel is navigating in the open sea. To disable the "In Transit" option, enable "Hide In Transit location option" in the setting of the relevant form group(s).

title: Where does the 'Effective Date' on forms pull from?
text: If a form designer form has a field with the ID ReportTime, then that is what is used for the effective date. For Standard Forms, a hidden date field is used which gets set to PS activity time if it exists, otherwise it is the earliest activity time.

title: Where do I enter the "Performance Warranty" details found in the Voyage Performance Report
text: The values of the Performance Warranty table are taken from the Time Charter under the Performance tab. [image][image]

title: Why am I receiving voyage reports from a vessel my company hasn't operated in while?
text: This is caused by the vessel master using old Veslink Forms mapped to your organization. Be sure the vessel has been deactivated in your Data Center and is not active for Veslink. Additionally ensure the vessel has been removed from all active Veslink Form Groups.

title: Why are values entered in Voyage Reporting forms rounding up?
text: If Voyage Reporting form values are being rounded, in the Form Designer, verify that the element Type is set to Decimal and that Decimal Places is set to a value greater than 0. [image]

title: Why can't the port agent see the Forms link, such as Port Disbursements and Statement of Facts, in Veslink?
text: This may be due to the Default Form Sharing not being enabled for the nominated agent. You can enable Form Sharing in either Veslink or IMOS by entering the specific Vessel, Voyage Number, and Partner Agent, then selecting the forms you wish to share.

title: Why is data from Approved Voyage Reporting forms not updating the voyage?
text: The importing and processing of data is handled by the imosmsg user in the database. If the imosmsg user does not have the necessary Object Rights permissions for Company, Vessel, or Vessel Type, then the Voyage Reporting form data will not be processed.

title: Why is my custom MRV report displaying negative consumption and/or CO2 emissions?
text: Negative values for consumption are likely the cause of incorrect bunker data. Navigate to Voyage Manager > Reports > Voyage Operational Report. Check for and correct any errors such as negative propulsion values. Save the Activity Reports and the Voyage, then refresh the report in Analytics module by selecting Enter Design Mode > Save.

title: Why is my Forms List empty?
text: When the Forms List is blank with no column headers, it is possible that there are no columns enabled for the list. Click on the "column" icon at top of the page to reveal the column selection panel and select the columns to be displayed. [image]

title: Daylight Saving FAQ
text: Does IMOS acknowledge daylight savings time? Yes, IMOS does acknowledge daylight savings time. For example, if you create a Laytime Port Activity with a DateTime of 3/14/21 2 am CST, which is when daylight saving time starts, IMOS automatically changes the value to 3/14/21 3 am when tabbing out of the cell.

title: IMOS - Setting ribbon color
text: To set the color in the ribbon you will need to set the flag CFGLibCrMasthead. In the value box, you will be able to set the 3 HEX colours separated by a comma (e.g. #469130, #469130, #469130). For a gradient in the ribbon, select different color codes.
